teams._doc: A band member (never Robin) can lead Merry Men on an ordinary job away from the band. The odds: base + per_member for each in the team, less per_threat for each point of threat, trap for each trap nobody knows of and bait for a bait job, plus the leader's odds, times the team's health, kept between min and max. Each leader has a knack (leaders): more gold, fewer wounds (hurt scales the damage) or more reputation; note is its tag on the leader's button. The team is gone days (plus the road there); they bring home share of the purse (the men keep the rest); a lost job sends one of them to the cells, the leader with leader_caught chance.
